tools.name: search
tools.description: Search free PermitReporter reviewed guides and coverage guidance. Returns guide IDs and canonical URLs. Use the paid search_permits tool for collected permit records.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a guide:ID for free, or a permit:ID for 0.005 USDC via x402. Permit records retain source, record date, collection timestamp and coverage limits.

tools.name: search_permits
tools.description: Costs 0.005 USDC via x402; empty results are unbilled. Search privacy-minimized collected building-permit records by public text, US county, city, PermitReporter trade classification or record-date range. Coverage spans 34 states and the District of Columbia; name a county bare for Georgia ('Cobb')

tools.name: get_permit_record
tools.description: Retrieve one privacy-minimized collected building-permit record by PermitReporter record ID, including its canonical citation, official source link and collection timestamp. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402; a missing record is unbilled.

tools.name: get_county_coverage
tools.description: Return the current source route, issuer, cadence, lag, through-date, collected record count, sources and statistical floor for one covered US county. Call this before interpreting a missing county result.

tools.name: get_contractor_leads
tools.description: Return recent, source-linked collected permits classified by trade and project scope for contractor research within the last days ending today (default 30). Costs 0.01 USDC via x402; empty results are unbilled. Classifications are editorial signals, not official fields or guaranteed work.

tools.name: get_statewide_snapshot
tools.description: Return current PermitReporter counts, route-status boundaries, record-date range and latest collection timestamp without returning personal data. Pass `state` with a two-letter code to get that one jurisdiction's collected coverage, including an explicit answer for states where nothing has been coll

tools.name: create_permit_watch
tools.description: Create a pending email watch only after the user reviews the exact email, search query and optional county, explicitly authorizes this request and confirmation email, and accepts https://permitreporter.com/terms and https://permitreporter.com/privacy. This additive action stores the email and search

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, create_permit_watch · Private data: search, fetch, search_permits, get_permit_record, get_county_coverage, get_statewide_snapshot, create_permit_watch · Public sink: create_permit_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, create_permit_watch · Private data: search, fetch, search_permits, get_permit_record, get_county_coverage, get_statewide_snapshot, create_permit_watch · Public sink: create_permit_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search PermitReporter reviewed guidance and privacy-minimized collected building-permit records. Returns canonical URLs for citation. Call fetch with a returned ID for the full source." → after: "Search free PermitReporter reviewed guides and coverage guidance. Returns guide IDs and canonical URLs. Use the paid search_permits tool for collected permit records."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
